plan.notes: Terrain not surveyed; the desert/jungle border is taken as described and the wall line follows the middle of the claim.

waits.words: The great dividing wall: walls come with a later Architect release; the town is built first and the wall is offered when it can be.
The two-sided desert and jungle material rule: palette rules come with a later release; the buildings are written now with a pending style and rebound once the style bible exists.

answer.summary: A 17-building twin-sided trade town on the desert-jungle border: jungle spice farms, apothecaries and stilted cottages on one side, glassworks, mine head and miners' houses on the other, with a central gatehouse, border market and caravan inn. The great dividing wall and the two-faced material rule are written down but wait for a later Architect release.
